# laravelforge_org_server_credential_vpc (Resource)

Manages a VPC (private network) created at a server provider via a Forge organization's server credential and region. The Forge API exposes only create and read for VPCs (no update, no delete), so this resource is create-and-read only: every attribute is create-time, and destroying the resource removes it from state without deleting the VPC at the provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential` (Number) ID of the server credential used to reach the provider.
- `name` (String) Name of the VPC. Create-only.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `region` (String) Provider region the VPC is created in.

### Read-Only

- `cidr_block` (String) CIDR block of the VPC.
- `id` (String) ID of the VPC at the provider.
